ch0130_41_serena/0101_0701_01_10:
I’ve been waiting,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]! I’m happy we
could meet again!
ch0130_41_serena/0101_0701_02_10:
*giggle* I have a feeling something special
will happen today!
ch0130_41_serena/7101_0701_01_10:
What do you think? I tried to find an elegant
outfit to match the festival!
ch0130_41_serena/7101_0701_02_10:
When I wear this outfit, I can’t help but get
excited!
ch0130_41_serena/7102_0701_01_10:
Isn’t it wonderful how during a celebration,
you can watch people and Pokémon shine
brighter?
ch0130_41_serena/7102_0701_02_10:
On a day like this, a battle could be truly
special.
ch0130_41_serena/7102_0701_03_10:
How about it? Won’t you have a memorable
Pokémon battle with me?
ch0130_41_serena/7103_0701_02_10:
They’re all precious friends I’ve grown
alongside.
ch0130_41_serena/7103_0701_03_10:
I want to see many new sights with my
Pokémon!
ch0130_41_serena/7104_0701_01_10:
Nessa and Elesa have different fashion
senses.
ch0130_41_serena/7104_0701_02_10:
Don’t you think their fashion brings out their
charm?
ch0130_41_serena/7104_0701_03_10: I want to refine a style of my own too!
ch0130_41_serena/7105_0701_01_10:
Hey, [Name:PlayerNickname ]! It’s a day
of celebration, so let’s go outside with
everyone!
ch0130_41_serena/7105_0701_02_10:
I’m sure we can make some fun memories
if we invite Calem and Shauna.
ch0130_41_serena/7105_0701_03_10:
And, of course, hanging out with just you
would be wonderful too!
ch0130_41_serena/1701_0701_02_10: It’s a present filled with festive spirit!
ch0130_41_serena/2501_0701_01_10: In Kalos, a parade was held in Lumiose City!
ch0130_41_serena/2501_0701_02_10:
Lots of people and Pokémon filled the streets.
It was a sight to behold. I wish you could’ve
seen it!
ch0130_41_serena/2501_0702_01_10:
People gathering to celebrate is a wondrous
thing, isn’t it?
ch0130_41_serena/2511_0701_01_10:
Fashion isn’t just about chasing trends.
It’s also about how you express yourself.
ch0130_41_serena/2511_0701_02_10:
Pokémon battles are the same. Being on
Pasio reminded me of that.
ch0130_41_serena/2511_0701_03_10: That’s why I want to try all sorts of styles...
ch0130_41_serena/2511_0701_04_10:
and broaden my horizons for battling AND
fashion!
ch0130_41_serena/2511_0702_01_10: Hmmm... Shall we start by going shopping?
ch0130_41_serena/2511_0702_02_10:
I’ll pick out a wonderful outfit for you—one
that’s perfect for a celebration!
ch0130_41_serena/3001_0701_01_10:
When I wake up in the morning and think
about what to do and what to wear, I get
so excited!
ch0130_41_serena/3003_0701_01_10:
It’s so wonderful celebrating and sharing
happiness with everyone! I can’t help but
smile!
ch0130_41_serena/3005_0701_01_10:
Today was fun, huh? Let’s get ready to make
tomorrow lovely, too!
